title: Resolution 2026-73 — monthly financial reporting (unsigned county-supplied copy)

pages.text:
RESOLUTION NO. 2026-73

A RESOLUTION REQUIRING MONTHLY ACCOUNTING AND FINANCIAL
REPORTS OF COUNTY FINANCES; REPEALING INCONSISTENT
RESOLUTIONS; PROVIDING FOR AN EFFECTIVE DATE; AND FOR OTHER
PURPOSES.

                                 W I T N E S S E T H:

       WHEREAS, Baldwin County (the “County”) is a duly formed political
subdivision of the State of Georgia;

       WHEREAS, the Baldwin County Board of Commissioners (the “Board”) is the
governing authority of the County, elected by the qualified electors of Baldwin County and
vested with legislative responsibilities necessary to the managing of the affairs of the
County government, as well as the health, safety, and welfare of the citizens of Baldwin
County;

       WHEREAS, monthly financial statements and reports will assist the Board in
carrying out its fiscal oversight responsibilities;

    WHEREAS, the Board desires to promote transparency, accountability, and public
confidence in the Board’s budgeting, management, and oversight of County finances; and

    WHEREAS, the Board has determined that requiring the preparation and presentation
of comprehensive accounting and financial reports concerning County finances on a
monthly basis is in the best interest of the citizens of Baldwin County;

     WHEREAS, the Board requires that the initial comprehensive accounting and
financial report will be completed and presented by the County Manager or his or her
authorized designee to the Board no later than thirty (30) days following the adoption of
this Resolution; and

     WHEREAS, following the initial financial report, the Board requires comprehensive
accounting and financial reports to be presented by the County Manager or his or her
authorized designee at its first monthly regular meeting each month and at such other times
as the Board may so instruct the County Manager;

    NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED by the Board of Commissioners of
Baldwin County, Georgia, and it is hereby resolved by authority of the same, as follows:

       1. Incorporation of Recitals. The above stated recitals are true and correct and
          are incorporated as though fully set forth herein.

       2. Requirement of Monthly Comprehensive Accounting and Financial
          Report. The Board hereby approves and implements a requirement for the
          County Manager or his or her authorized designee to ensure the preparation and

presentation of monthly accounting and financial reports to the Board at its first
          regular meeting each month. The monthly accounting and financial report shall
          include, at a minimum, a snapshot of the County’s cash position including
          account balances and encumbrances, a year-to-date budget-to-actual report for
          each County department, and a comprehensive accounting of all active and
          completed County projects, including the project budget, funding sources,
          expenditures incurred to date, outstanding obligations, encumbrances, and
          liabilities, and an overview of the current financial status of each such project,
          as well as such other and further information as the Board may desire.

      3. Severability. In case any one or more of the provisions of this resolution shall
         for any reason be held to be illegal or invalid, such illegality or invalidity shall
         not affect any other provision of this resolution, but this resolution shall be
         construed and enforced as if such illegal or invalid provision had not been
         contained herein.

      4. Repeal of Conflicting Resolutions. Any and all resolutions in conflict with
         this resolution this day passed be and they are hereby repealed.

      5. Effective Date.      This Resolution shall take effect immediately upon its
         adoption.


SO RESOLVED, this 25th day of September, 2026.



BALDWIN COUNTY, GEORGIA


___________________________________
Honorable Kendrick Butts
Chairman, Baldwin County Board of Commissioners
